id./param/scenario/cs/a_180_cs_030.pack|cs_: "O Yggdrasil, who watches over the lives of the world... Today, a new life is born in Arboria.
"A life that once fell as an old leaf now sprouts as a new one... and will walk a different path.
"O Yggdrasil, our mother, we beg You to bless this tender young bud of holy Arboria...
"Well, well! The twin sages, Veronica and Serena! How long have you been standing there?
"Good day, Holy Father. It's ever so nice to see you. Everyone seems well.
"...Hm? Veronica, you seem to have shrunk a good deal since we last met.
"Err... It's a long story.
"Anyway, listen! We did as you asked. We found the Luminary!
"The Luminary...!?
"Oh... The Luminary, on the very day of a baby's blessing! What a blessed day this is...
"I am Benedictus, High Priest of Arboria. I have waited many years for the day we would meet.
"Holy Father, we traveled the whole world, and finally learned of a wicked being who hunts the Luminary's life...
"I see. So this Mordegon has taken the place of someone in Heliodor and means to destroy the Luminary...?
"To defeat him, we're going to Yggdrasil, where something that dispels the darkness is said to sleep.
"We can reach the World Tree by offering six Orbs at the altar atop the First Forest.
"I once dreamed that you two climbed a towering mountain toward Yggdrasil with the Luminary.
"I took it for Yggdrasil's oracle, and sent you both to find the Luminary. And now...
"Now all is clear. The dream showed the Luminary going to the altar atop the First Forest.
"The path to the First Forest lies beyond the cathedral ahead.
"I shall wait in the cathedral. When you have gathered all six Orbs, come to me."
